annotations.text:
kennethgm.com — Kenneth Granados

One page, bilingual EN/ES, two audiences: freelance clients up top, recruiters further down. Client names never appear; engagements are described by domain, the way your CVs do it.

Accent colour is a tweak on every artboard — change it in one place and the whole system follows.
OPTION A — particle constellation. Engineered and precise. Real canvas, drifts slowly, links points that come close, and goes fully static under reduced motion.
OPTION B — drifting mesh gradient with heavy grain. Warmer and more atmospheric. Your name is the hero instead of the headline, with a stack ticker along the bottom.
Cards tilt toward the pointer on desktop, off on touch. The two image panels are placeholders until I capture the live sites.
The recruiter half. No team sizes and no weekly hours anywhere, as you asked.
How I work is three principles, not four. The fourth was availability in hours, so it is gone.
Mobile at 375px. Tilt is off on touch, every button is 46px or taller, and the particle field runs at about a third of the desktop point count so it does not drain a phone.
